correctness.rationale: RESULT.md proves over GF(2), for d>=2, A²=(d mod 2)I via commuting involutory coordinate flips. H=A+delta I has H²=0 and rank 2^(d-1); with e at one origin, D=H+ee^T has rank h+1, D² image span(e,He), and restriction [[1,delta],[1,0]]. Even d therefore has one fixed line and nilpotent J3(0) plus h-2 J2(0) blocks; the exact entry shells follow from kernel ranks. Odd d yields one irreducible degree-two 3-cycle factor and h-1 unipotent J2(1) blocks, yielding exact primitive orbit counts for 1,2,3,6. Independently exhaustively reimplemented direct GF2 state updates for d=2,3,4; first-entry d2=(2,2,4,8), d4=(2,254,32512,32768), d3 period-state populations (8,56,24,168) all match. These finite tests are not the infinite proof. No claim beyond one self-feedback defect, even/odd d>=2, or unlabelled orbit quotient.
